```{r}
#| out-width: 70%
#| fig-align: center

library(tidyverse)

#Borrowed from TidyTuesday instructions
transit_cost <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2021/2021-01-05/transit_cost.csv')

country_total <- transit_cost |>
  group_by(country) |>
  filter(country == "US" |
         country == "CN" |
         country == "BR" |
         country == "FR" |
         country == "AE") |>
  summarize(cost_km_millions = mean(cost_km_millions))

ggplot(country_total, aes(x = country, y = cost_km_millions, fill = country)) +
  geom_col() +
    labs(
    title = "Transit Infrastructure Project Costs by Country",
    x = "Country Code",
    y = "Cost Per KM in Millions of USD"
  ) +
  
  #Centered format
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

Data is downloaded from TidyTuesday.[^1]  Data is courtesy of the Transit Costs Project.[^2]  Header image is from LiveWorkDream.[^3]

[^1]: <https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/blob/main/data/2021/2021-01-05/readme.md>

[^2]: <https://transitcosts.com/>

[^3]: <https://liveworkdream.com/2022/10/14/are-train-tracks-and-railroad-tracks-the-same/>
